core.summary: Cross-layer language changes and compiler infrastructure
hazards: Keep generated executable blocks independent of the reference evaluator.
Assess Python/Lean schema alignment and both JSON codecs; regenerate explicitly.
Focused tests are not full verification; slow markers do not isolate Lean tests.

calls.summary: White-box helper expansion, hoisting, frame hygiene, and compositional certificates
hazards: Preserve eager arguments, unused arguments, failure order, and fresh private frames.
Hoisted temporaries must not enter phi merges or loop-carried headers.
Caller _lowering alone does not establish callee source agreement; use _program_lowering.
Do not move calls out of short-circuit or repeatedly evaluated conditions to bypass rejection.

selection.summary: Eager min/max and lazy scalar conditional expressions
hazards: min/max evaluate both operands once, left to right; ties and NaNs retain the original first operand.
Conditional expressions evaluate only the chosen branch; selection cannot use computed-NaN exemptions.
Selection uses the certified backend even without statement-level control flow.

arrays.summary: Functional arrays, bounds failures, value kinds, phi merges, and store order
hazards: Updates are functional values in tagged slots, not mutable shared references.
Stores evaluate the RHS before the array and index; invalid indices are explicit failures.
Array parameters, returns, aliases, and helper-local arrays remain unsupported.

float.summary: Raw binary64 transport, arithmetic policy, and exact-vs-native readings
hazards: Preserve signed zeros and NaN payloads; use bit comparisons, not approximate equality.
Only computed arithmetic NaNs have a narrow counted exemption; never broaden it automatically.
Native arithmetic agreement is tested, not proved; this is not Python's complete numeric tower.

proofs.summary: Proof routing, polynomial normalization, fuel refinement, and spec links
hazards: rat_ring handles integer-coefficient polynomials; clear rational literal denominators first.
Rewrite certified wrappers with _compiled_link instead of unfolding literal-fuel execution.
Exhaustion is not divergence; partial correctness is not termination.
Native samples belong only in NativeTests.lean / PontifexNativeTests, never certificate imports.

lowering.summary: Reference lowering, SSA merges, structured fuel, and kernel reduction cost
hazards: Retain kernel-reducible reference algorithms; lowerRec is intentionally proof-only/noncomputable.
Preserve the linear-cost regression before raising heartbeat budgets.
Fuel is structured execution depth, not a global instruction counter.
